public_revenue_training.provider_regression_guard: Each provider validation normalized MAE may worsen no more than 2% versus seasonal naive; select smallest qualified provider-balanced normalized MAE
public_revenue_training.validation_target: Provider-specific geographic and terminal-time validation; Uzbekistan January-December 2025 is legacy development validation
public_revenue_training.test_protocol: Fresh independent international geographic plus terminal-year holdout is constructed explicitly only after model freeze; previous Uzbekistan and synthetic test outcomes are legacy regression benchmarks.
public_revenue_training.selection_metric: Provider-balanced macro per-history-normalized validation MAE; training loss weight equal by provider; no final test outcomes used

abs.grouping: Provider-prefixed state/province; all industry series from one geography stay together. Sector records are dependent aggregate series, not independent firms.
abs.split_algorithm: SHA256('international-region-v1:' + provider + ':' + geography), sorted; floor(0.6*n) train, half remaining validation/test
abs.quality_policy: Reject an entire case if any required history/target month is missing, suppressed, unreliable, nonfinite or negative. Published zero sales remain actual zeros; all-zero history is excluded.
abs.test_policy: Terminal test labels are imported but must not be read for training or validation selection; build test cases only after final model freeze.

statcan.grouping: Provider-prefixed state/province; all industry series from one geography stay together. Sector records are dependent aggregate series, not independent firms.
statcan.split_algorithm: SHA256('international-region-v1:' + provider + ':' + geography), sorted; floor(0.6*n) train, half remaining validation/test
statcan.quality_policy: Reject an entire case if any required history/target month is missing, suppressed, unreliable, nonfinite or negative. Published zero sales remain actual zeros; all-zero history is excluded.
statcan.test_policy: Terminal test labels are imported but must not be read for training or validation selection; build test cases only after final model freeze.

public_revenue_training.temporal_scope: Holdouts are provider-local terminal years; Uzbekistan training through December 2025 overlaps some Australian/Canadian holdout dates. No absolute year, provider identity or cross-country shock covariates are features; this is not a globally chronological unseen-future test.
public_revenue_training.limitations: Original retail turnover and service value are aggregate revenue proxies, not independent firm cash receipts. Native currency units remain separate and only dimensionless errors are pooled. Survey revisions, correlated economic shocks, Uzbekistan short post-methodology histories, and cross-country aggregate-to-borrower transfer limit claims. No real costs, defaults or repayments are supplied.

selection.expense_training: Actual generated outflows from synthetic training businesses only; the optional observation-based cost regression is fitted only to the scored borrower's past inflow/outflow transactions. No public expense/default labels
selection.transfer_acceptance_gate: Selected real revenue candidate must actively use its real-data-fitted estimator; provider-balanced validation normalized MAE improves seasonal naive by at least 5%; downstream synthetic validation pooled MAE must improve and macro normalized MAE may worsen no more than 2%. No test labels enter acceptance.
selection.transfer_selection_metric: Same 60 held-out-from-fitting synthetic validation businesses, future-12-month pooled and macro normalized net MAE; real revenue candidate chosen separately by provider-balanced real entity/time validation only. Legacy test sets are not fresh confirmation.

public_calibration.source: Uzbekistan SIAT retail aggregate turnover, CC BY 4.0

test_protocol.interpretation: The fixed test cohort was reported before this model upgrade. It is excluded from fitting and selection, but is no longer a fresh confirmatory holdout. International final-period cases provide the new real-revenue evaluation.
test_protocol.capacity_and_schedule_population: Only positive-principal businesses; zero-loan cohorts reported separately
test_protocol.overload_definition: payment > actual future net surplus; a zero payment in a negative-surplus month also counts
test_protocol.annuity_comparator: Same indexed principal, 12-month term and explicitly 0% APR; equal installments
test_protocol.mape_policy: Exclude abs(actual)<1 index. Negative actuals use absolute denominator. MAPE remains unstable near zero and is not the selection metric.

seasonality.ground_truth: Future realised net-flow bottom/top quartiles, not generator seasonal parameters

max_20000_transaction_request.construction: Repeated generated synthetic transaction events; latency-only, not a capacity accuracy test

latency.scope: Single process, warm model, sequential local TestClient. Includes JSON validation, response serialization and durable audit; excludes network/load and train/startup.
